kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the block's header + intro + five-row four-column class table + footnotes.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the table; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The ISOFORM-FORK frame — the five printed rows compressed into one fork question: WHICH PDE does the drug inhibit? The numbered lanes PDE-3 (milrinone — the inotrope; and cilostazol, a PDE-3 member filed by indication under the platelet pair per the printed footnote a), PDE-4 (roflumilast — the airway-inflammation lane), PDE-5 (sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil, avanafil — the cGMP lane) — plus the NONSPECIFIC pair (theophylline, the rarely-used methylxanthine; dipyridamole, the platelet row's other member per the printed footnote b). The rows, the isoform numbers, and both footnotes are printed; the fork compression is KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The five rows, the isoform numbers, and the categorizing footnotes are printed; the unified fork reading is KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea + mechanisms[0] + the visual's fork cards

kypExtensions.summary: The CYCLIC-NUCLEOTIDE-CURRENCY frame — the cAMP camp (PDE-3, PDE-4, and both nonspecifics: milrinone, roflumilast, theophylline, cilostazol, dipyridamole — ↑ cAMP at one of four addresses: cardiomyocyte, neutrophil/bronchial epithelium, bronchial smooth muscle, platelet) vs the cGMP camp (PDE-5 alone: sildenafil, vardenafil, tadalafil, avanafil — ↓ hydrolysis of cGMP → ↑ cGMP, the NO-enhancing lane). The currency rows print on book 237 ('β1 | s', 'β2 | s' — Gs; 'Adenylyl cyclase', 'GS protein', 'ATP', 'Cyclic AMP'); the camp split that turns one enzyme family into two clinical universes is KYP's.
kypExtensions.rationale: The currency rows are printed on the completed PH16 page; the camp split is KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + mechanisms[0] + the visual's mechanism strip + the mnemonic 'cAMP acts, cGMP relaxes'

kypExtensions.summary: The NITRATE-SEPARATION protocol (NOT printed on this page — flagged wherever used): the page prints only the adverse-effect cell 'hypotension in patients taking nitrates' — the contraindication as a toxicity token, never as a rule; the classic protocol (do not combine; when both are needed, separate the doses — 24+ hours for sildenafil and vardenafil, 48+ hours for tadalafil, given the half-lives; treat the interaction with pressure support, not vasopressors first) is KYP's clinical overlay, attached to the printed cell and flagged.
kypExtensions.rationale: The printed cell names the interaction; the timing rules and the management are clinical-pharmacology standards attached as a flagged overlay.
kypExtensions.location: usmle traps[1] + the miniCase + the visual's caution strip
